'''Sivron station''' was a small hidden hangar bay located in the [[Jacent Valley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] where a group of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] built a prototype stealth [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] during the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|Battle of Balmorra]]. However, the Republic pilots were [[Death/Legends|killed]] and the shuttle stolen by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
